newsitem.title: USA: Unocal says unit buys back $507 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says unit buys back $507 mln in debt.

text.p: Unocal Corp on Friday said its unit, Union Oil Co of California, has acquired $507 million of its outstanding debt securities, substantially completing Unocal's $800 million debt reduction plan.
The company paid about $555 million to repurchase The debt. The payment included a pre-tax premium of about $48 million which will be charged to second quarter earnings.

The $507 million in principal covered about 72 percent of three outstanding debt issues, carried an average interest coupon of 9.27 percent and saved the company about $47 million in interest annually, Unocal said in a statement.
The buyback was funded with proceeds from the March sale of Unocal's West Coast refining, marketing and transportation assets.
